h: Tope Alabi reportedly gives Canada-based pastor 24 hours over online claims about Toluwanisings' death
p: Gospel singer Tope Alabi has reportedly given a Canada-based pastor a 24-hour ultimatum in the controversy surrounding the death of Toluwanisings. This follows her earlier warning to social media users against defamation.
more: She has said she will take legal action against defamation.
Many Nigerians are weighing in online.
